units.source_text: 總之，我不過是日本東北的哈羅德·勞埃德罷了。

en.t: In short, I was nothing more than the Harold Lloyd of northeastern Japan.

units.source_text: 竹一那句愚蠢的奉承話，成為可恨的預言活生生地呈現出不祥的兆頭，是多年以後的事。

en.t: It was many years later that Takeichi's foolish compliment came alive as a hateful prophecy and began to show ominous signs.

units.source_text: 竹一還送了我一份重要的禮物。

en.t: Takeichi also gave me an important gift.
This is a picture of a monster, you know.

units.source_text: 有一次，竹一到我的二樓來玩時，沾沾自喜地拿出一幅原色版的卷頭插圖給我看，這樣說道。

en.t: Once, when Takeichi came up to my second-floor room to play, he proudly took out a color frontispiece and showed it to me, saying this.

units.source_text: 那一瞬間，我的墮落之路似乎就被註定了，直到多年後我仍這麼認為。

en.t: Even many years later, I still feel that my path toward ruin was fixed in that instant.

units.source_text: 我知道那不過是梵高的自畫像而已。

en.t: I knew it was nothing more than a self-portrait by Van Gogh.
